purpose: Single-line password input for forms. Renders a bordered field with a built-in visibility toggle button on the trailing edge that flips the native `type` between `password` and `text`. Shares the visual language of `Input` (same heights, borders, focus ring, disabled treatment). The component is the field only — labels, helper text, and strength meters live in the wrapping form-field layer. Aligned with Figma frame `3714:10788` (Webkit / PasswordInput). The token mapping was originally inferred from the `input` sibling because the Figma MCP was unreachable during spec authoring; it has since been **reconciled against the frame** as rendered inside the password field frame (`2027:3212`), which corrected the trailing padding to `var(--spacing-xs)` and the visibility toggle to the 28 px (`small`) `IconButton`. One frame value is deliberately not adopted: the border width stays at the shared 1 px rather than the frame's `var(--border-width-default)` (0.8 px), because this component's contract is to share `Input`'s borders and `Input` is still on 1 px — moving one without the other would break that stated invariant. Adopting it is a coordinated follow-up across every bordered input.
useWhen: A bare password field whose label and errors are laid out separately (an inline re-authentication prompt, a custom form row).
Any secret the user may need to check while typing (passwords, tokens); the built-in toggle reveals it as plain text.
avoidWhen: A password field with a label, helper or error text, or a requirements row → wrap it in a `field` (with `password-requirements` for the rules row).
The value is not secret → use `input`.
related: field` — wraps this input with its label and description; it hands the input its id, `aria-describedby` and state.
password-requirements` — the live checklist of password rules rendered under this input.
input` — plain-text field with the same borders, focus ring, and disabled treatment.
bestPractices: Set `autocomplete="new-password"` on sign-up and password-change forms; keep the default `current-password` on login.
Leave `toggleable` on; turn it off only when you need the `iconRight` slot, which is ignored while the toggle is shown.
The field is a fixed 40px tall with no `size` prop; align it with `size="large"` siblings in the same row.
Give it an accessible name: a `label` whose `for` matches an `id` passed to the input, or `aria-label`.
